params:
1 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, finely diced
2 carrots, grated
2 cloves garlic
500 g beef mince
400 g tin chopped tomatoes
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 cup beef stock
400 g spaghetti
Parmesan, to serve

1. Soften the onion and carrot in oil for 8 minutes.
2. Add garlic and mince; brown well.
3. Stir in tomatoes, paste and stock. Simmer 45 minutes.
4. Cook the spaghetti, toss with sauce and serve with Parmesan.

params:
600 g chicken thighs, sliced
3 bell peppers, sliced
1 red onion, sliced
2 tbsp fajita seasoning
2 tbsp olive oil
8 small tortillas
1 lime
Sour cream

1. Heat oven to 220°C.
2. Toss chicken, peppers and onion with oil and seasoning.
3. Roast 22 minutes, turning once.
4. Squeeze over lime and serve in warm tortillas.

params:
2 cups plain flour
2 tbsp sugar
2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp baking soda
2 cups buttermilk
2 eggs
3 tbsp melted butter
Maple syrup

1. Whisk the dry ingredients.
2. Whisk buttermilk, eggs and butter; fold into the dry mix. Leave lumpy.
3. Rest 5 minutes.
4. Cook on a medium griddle until bubbles pop, flip, 1 minute more.
Add blueberries after pouring, not in the batter.

params: Uses up the three brown bananas.

3 ripe bananas
1/3 cup melted butter
3/4 cup sugar
1 egg
1 tsp vanilla
1 tsp baking soda
Pinch of salt
1 1/2 cups plain flour
1/2 cup walnuts

1. Heat oven to 175°C and line a loaf tin.
2. Mash bananas with butter.
3. Stir in sugar, egg and vanilla, then soda, salt and flour.
4. Fold in walnuts and bake 55–60 minutes.
Leave the walnuts out for school lunches.

params:
225 g butter, browned
1 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup white sugar
2 eggs
2 tsp vanilla
2 3/4 cups flour
1 tsp baking soda
1 tsp salt
300 g dark chocolate chunks

1. Brown the butter and cool 10 minutes.
2. Beat with sugars, then eggs and vanilla.
3. Fold in flour, soda, salt and chocolate.
4. Chill 30 minutes. Bake at 180°C for 11 minutes.
Chilling the dough is not optional.

params:
500 g bread flour
400 g water
100 g active starter
10 g salt
4 tbsp olive oil
Flaky salt
Rosemary

1. Mix flour, water and starter; rest 30 minutes.
2. Add salt. Four folds over 2 hours.
3. Refrigerate overnight.
4. Tip into an oiled tray, proof 3 hours, dimple, top and bake at 230°C for 25 minutes.

1 tbsp butter
1 onion, diced
3 carrots, sliced
3 celery sticks, sliced
2 litres chicken stock
2 chicken breasts
200 g egg noodles
Parsley
Lemon

1. Soften the vegetables in butter.
2. Add stock and chicken; simmer 20 minutes.
3. Shred the chicken and return with the noodles for 8 minutes.
4. Finish with parsley and lemon.

1 1/2 cups red lentils
1 onion
3 cloves garlic
Thumb of ginger
1 tbsp curry powder
1 tsp turmeric
400 ml coconut milk
3 cups water
Spinach
Rice, to serve

1. Fry onion, garlic and ginger. Add the spices.
2. Add lentils, coconut milk and water. Simmer 20 minutes.
3. Stir through spinach and season.

params:
800 g stewing beef
2 tbsp flour
2 onions
3 carrots
2 parsnips
3/4 cup pearl barley
1 litre beef stock
2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
Thyme
Bay leaf

1. Flour and brown the beef in batches.
2. Soften the vegetables, return the beef, add stock and herbs.
3. Simmer covered 90 minutes.
4. Add barley and cook 40 minutes more.

1 red onion, quartered
6 cloves garlic
3 tbsp olive oil
2 cups vegetable stock
Basil
Splash of cream

2. Blend with stock and basil.
3. Warm through and finish with cream.

1 red pepper
2 carrots

1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp honey

Sesame oil
Rice

params: Friday pizza night dough and sauce.

500 g 00 flour
325 g water
7 g instant yeast
10 g salt
400 g tin San Marzano tomatoes
250 g fresh mozzarella
Basil
Olive oil

1. Mix and knead the dough; rise 90 minutes.
2. Crush tomatoes with salt.
3. Shape four bases, top, and bake on a hot stone at max heat for 7 minutes.
Kids do their own toppings on quarter trays.

350 g macaroni
3 tbsp butter
3 tbsp flour
2 1/2 cups milk
250 g sharp cheddar, grated
1 tsp mustard
Salt and pepper

1. Cook the pasta.
2. Make a roux, whisk in milk and simmer until thick.
3. Off the heat, melt in the cheese and mustard.
4. Fold in the pasta.

225 g caster sugar
4 eggs
225 g self-raising flour
Zest of 2 lemons

2 kg pork shoulder
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp smoked paprika
1 tbsp salt
1 tsp garlic powder
1 cup apple cider
1 cup barbecue sauce
Brioche buns
Coleslaw

1. Rub the pork and place in the slow cooker with the cider.
2. Cook on low 8 hours.
3. Shred, stir in the sauce and pile onto buns.
